## Area: system-level average router area relative to DeFT (hierarchical, as v18)

Routers weighted 12 chiplet, 4 boundary, 12 interposer, 4 interposer + VL. RTL with the cost register (the design N_fast applies to). Form P: one unit per input port, the form the simulator models. Form S: one unit per router; a head on the link cannot enter stage A when another port holds the unit, which the simulator does not charge.

| variant | form P: 2x2 / 3x3 / 4x4 | form S: 2x2 / 3x3 / 4x4 | v18 slow form S, same scope and kind |
